overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notices at the official location and approve minutes timely, but ordered no further relief because remedial steps were planned.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council failed to file meeting notices with the Town Clerk for meetings held in the 2019-2020 school year.
allegations.key_passage: The Council concedes that it did not post meeting notices at the official location through the Town Clerk during the school year commencing July 1, 2019.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council failed to create, approve, and post meeting minutes for its 2019-2020 school year meetings.
allegations.key_passage: The Council concedes that it did not create and approve meeting minutes for its meetings that took place during the 2019-2020 school year.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council failed to post meeting minutes; the AG addressed whether the law requires posting minutes to a municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: We note that the Open Meeting Law does not require public bodies to post meeting minutes to a municipal website.
